purpose: Teach: 晋/炉/包装/試みる/封筒/簡素/直結/軽視

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 晋さん、現場運営、引き続きよろしく。
lines.en: Shin-san, I need you to keep overseeing operations on the ground.
lines.style: Professional, clear directives. Measured pace. Lean forward slightly—this is a handoff moment. Warm but not casual. Expectation of competence underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い炉、保守を試みる予定です。
lines.en: Yes. I'm planning to attempt maintenance on the old furnace.
lines.style: Steady, dutiful tone. Matter-of-fact cadence. No flourish—just confirming the task. Eyes engaged, shoulders settled. The ease of someone who knows what they're doing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 包装ラインも、簡素な構成に変更を。
lines.en: And change the packaging line to a simpler setup.
lines.style: Directive but not sharp. Light emphasis on 'simpler'—clarity matters more than speed here. Speaking from experience. Slight forward motion in phrasing, as if moving down a checklist together.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 監査資料、封筒で発送、データは社内システムに直結させます。
lines.en: I'll get the audit materials out by mail in envelopes. The data goes directly into the internal system.
lines.style: Efficient confirmation. Clipped rhythm, no hesitation. He's already thinking through the steps. Neutral, professional tone—reporting back completion of understanding.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 労務管理、軽視しないように。
lines.en: And don't cut corners on labor management.
lines.style: Quiet weight on those last three words. Not a lecture—a gentle warning from experience. Softer than the previous lines. Eye contact steady. The moment where she moves from logistics to what actually matters.
